Meta.title: Previously — Previously on you.
Meta.description: an open-source personal AI agent that organizes memory by time — a single timeline of episodic slices, not chat threads

Hero.title: Your AI, organized by time — not by threads.
Hero.subtitle: an open-source personal AI agent that organizes memory by time — a single timeline of episodic slices, not chat threads

Screen2.title: Time, not conversations.
Screen2.description: Most AI agents organize your content by conversation threads. Previously organizes everything chronologically — a single, continuous timeline where every moment has its place.

Screen3.title: Grows with you.
Screen3.description: Previously refines how it thinks and remembers — drawing from every conversation and its own reflections. It iterates on its own, getting better at helping you, one chat at a time.

Screen4.title: Every word matters.
Screen4.description: Previously keeps every conversation in its original form — raw, uncompressed, exactly as it happened. When you need something, it retrieves and assembles context on the fly.

Screen5.title: Travel back to any moment.
Screen5.description: Click any point on your timeline and you're there — reliving that conversation, seeing what the agent was thinking, picking up exactly where you left off. Not search. Not scroll. Time travel.

Screen6.title: Your memory. Your repository.
Screen6.description: Every conversation is a Markdown file in your own GitHub repo. No proprietary database. No cloud lock-in. No one else's server. Your data, your format, your control — forever.

Screen7.title: It works while you're away.
Screen7.description: Close the tab. Walk away. Previously keeps working — running background tasks, evolving its understanding, preparing for your next conversation. 'I come after you're done' isn't just a tagline. It's how it works.

Screen8.title: Open source. Self-host. No lock-in.
Screen8.description: MIT licensed. Run it on your own machine. Modify it. Extend it. Contribute back. Previously belongs to the community, not a corporation.

Screen9.title: Previously on you.
Screen9.description: Your AI, organized by time — not by threads. Open source. Self-hosted. Always yours.
